answer: Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the voyage queue naming the ember that holds the sponsor's bond. Therefore, each alias costs 10 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the zenith record shows exactly who is still on probation. A new identity serves a probation of 10 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. That is 4 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
